subject: ClearBridge: Console + API training slot coordination

From: Elliot Morris <elliot.morris@clearbridge.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Clara Ng <clara.ng@clearbridge.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Sep 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: ClearBridge: Training for Console + API access

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team found the performance/latency numbers compelling. Were ready to move to a joint onboarding session so our engineers and product owners can get hands-on with the Console and the API.

Scope: 90-120 minute combined session (console walkthrough + short API enablement). Audience: 6 engineers + 2 product managers.

Can you share availability for the week of Sep 15-19? If possible wed like an afternoon slot PT (3pm PT or later) so our APAC folks can join asynchronously. Also:
- Do you have a recommended order (console first, then API) or split hands-on labs?
- Any pre-reqs we should complete? Sandbox creds or dataset prep?

Were also starting procurement; if there are any documents you need (PO or SOW references) let me know.

Thanks,
Elliot
Elliot Morris
Head of Integrations, ClearBridge Finance
elliot.morris@clearbridge.com
+1 415-555-0186
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Elliot Morris <elliot.morris@clearbridge.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 03 Sep 2025 16:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ClearBridge: Training for Console + API access

Thanks Elliot — excited to get this set up.

Proposed options (all PT):
1) Tue Sep 16, 03:30-05:30 PM PT — 2hr combined: 60m Console walkthrough (incl. access & roles), 45m API hands-on, 15m Q&A
2) Thu Sep 18, 04:00-05:30 PM PT — 90m compact: console highlights + API quickstart + followup office hours next week

Id recommend option 1 if you want hands-on labs during the live session (we can provision sandbox keys ahead of time). Option 2 is better if the group prefers a shorter async-friendly session and a separate office hours slot.

Pre-reqs:
- One admin user per attendee (for Console role demo) OR we can demo with our trainer accounts
- API sandbox keys (we can create; just provide emails)
- A short list of 2-3 integration scenarios youd like us to cover (e.g., streaming generation for chat, embeddings pipeline for search)

Ive started a Kickoff runbook and attached a draft for your review: [Attachment: clearbridge_kickoff_runbook.pdf (PDF, 240KB)]. It also has agenda templates and an invite text you can forward internally.

Camila and Ben are on copy to coordinate trainer assignment and confirm whether we should record the session and deliverables.

Best,
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Elliot — quick note from the enablement side. Priyoms proposed slots both work for our delivery team, but we do have a conference travel conflict on Sep 16 afternoon that would require a backup. If youre willing to lock in Sep 16 as primary, wed ask for a 2hr buffer earlier that day for a dry run. Alternatively we can set Sep 18 as primary and offer Sep 23 as a late backup.

A couple of logistics items before we finalize:
- Please confirm attendee emails so we can pre-create sandbox API keys and Console reviewer roles.
- If you want the session recorded, well post the recording and the runbook to a shared folder (link included below).
- For SSO: do you use Okta? If so well need a technical contact to accept the test assertion later in the week.

Attachments: trainer_roster.xlsx (simple names + backup trainer).

Ive flagged Marissa for any procurement questions (in case ClearBridge needs customized SOW language for the onboarding session).

Camila Reyes
Enablement Lead, Redwood Inference
